info.title: GeoIP - IP Geolocation, ASN & ISP Lookup
info.description:
# GeoIP: IP Geolocation, ASN and ISP Lookup

Country-level IP geolocation with network intelligence for IPv4 and IPv6: country, continent, EU flag, ASN and the organisation that runs the network. Answers in milliseconds from a local database, with bulk lookups of up to 100 IPs.

**Who it's for:** SaaS and e-commerce teams localising content, enforcing geo rules or screening traffic, and analytics and security tools.

## Use cases
- Pre-select the right country, currency and language on first visit.
- Apply EU-specific consent or VAT logic with `is_eu`.
- Spot traffic from hosting providers and data centres via the ASN organisation.
- Enrich server logs and analytics events with country and ISP.
- Enforce country-based licensing or sanctions rules (as one signal among several).

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://geoip-ip-geolocation-asn-isp-lookup.p.rapidapi.com/lookup?ip=8.8.8.8' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: geoip-ip-geolocation-asn-isp-lookup.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`geoip-ip-geolocation-asn-isp-lookup.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- Precision is country level; city and coordinates are not provided.
- Private, loopback and reserved addresses are recognised and returned without location data.
- Every response includes an `attribution` string required by the data licence.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `413` input too large, `422` missing or invalid parameter, `503` temporarily unavailable, retry shortly. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- IP to country and ASN data: DB-IP Lite databases by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Attribution is included in every response.

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.description: Returns country, continent, EU membership, ASN and network organisation (ISP or hosting provider) for any IPv4 or IPv6 address, plus flags for private, loopback and multicast ranges. Served from a local database, so lookups take milliseconds.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address, e.g. 8.8.8.8 or 2a00:1450:4009::1.

example.error: ip must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address

get.summary: Look up the caller's own IP
get.description: Geolocates the IP the request appears to come from (the first address in X-Forwarded-For). Behind the RapidAPI gateway this is the address the gateway forwards, which may be the gateway itself rather than your end user; for production, pass the user's IP to /lookup.

example.attribution: IP geolocation by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com), CC BY 4.0

post.summary: Look up up to 100 IPs at once
post.description: Geolocates up to 100 addresses in one request. Results come back in input order; an invalid entry yields `{ip, error}` instead of failing the batch.

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

IpGeo.description: Geolocation for one IP address. For private, loopback and other non-public addresses only the address flags plus `country: null`, `asn: null` and `attribution` are returned.

is_eu.description: Country is an EU member state.

asn.description: Autonomous System Number of the network.

organization.description: Organisation that operates the AS (ISP, host or company).

attribution.description: Attribution string required by the DB-IP licence; display it where you show the data.

results.description: One entry per input, in order. Invalid inputs are `{ip, error}`.
